$description: Rhythm/position/dependency/compliance rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id has exactly one implementation in schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all.py checks parity both ways, and runs the validator over a PageSpec synthesised from every template to prove no rule rejects the real structure). Severity: error = invalid, warn = non-fatal notice.

rules.description: Cross-references the PageSpec's declared template against THAT template's node list: every node's (section, variant) must match a template node in template order, non-repeatable nodes appear once, every required template node is present.
template.home is homeRouteOnly: route must be one of its routes ("/").
shell.navbar is nodes[0].
The hero is nodes[1], directly after the navbar.
rules.exemptionNote: No exemption: the only template requires its hero.

rules.description: Exactly one hero.* node.
rules.exemptionNote: No hero-less template exists (templates.json: hero required).

rules.description: shell.footer follows every <main> section; only overlay.* nodes may come after it.
rules.templateCheck: templates.json: footer at index 10, followed only by the two overlays

rules.description: overlay.* nodes are rendered after the footer (siblings of <main>/<footer>).
overlay.floating-cta reads the hero video, the newsletter field and the navbar hidden state; it is invalid without them.
Every #target / #href (navbar links, floating CTA secondary) resolves to an anchorId on a node or inside node content (e.g. the AI Prompt export card).
anchorIds are unique on the page (they become DOM ids).
Two pinned scroll stages (sticky card stack, sticky scrub stage) should not be adjacent: the observed page separates them with the feature cards.
rules.templateCheck: templates.json: steps.sticky-stack (2) and showcase.breakpoint-scrub (4) are separated by cards.feature-carousel (3); the hero video scales in place and is not pinned.

rules.description: Adjacent nodes should not share a category (section contract `category`).

namedExceptions.reason: Both overlays are fixed-position siblings rendered after the footer; adjacency in the node list has no visual rhythm meaning.

rules.templateCheck: templates.json: the only same-category adjacency is the overlay pair (named exception); shell.navbar and shell.footer are never adjacent.

rules.description: Every node carries motion.reducedMotionFallback equal to its section contract's const.
motion.patterns is non-empty and a subset of the section's evidenced allowedPatterns.
Per-instance word budgets from each section contract (and template page budgets) hold for every node in THIS PageSpec.

measuredFrom.expect: **Content rule:** long copy is not transcribed.

rules.description: Every assetRole is in the closed vocabulary and settable.
assetRef prefix is allowed by the role's generationPolicy (proprietary media: generated: only; marks/trademarks: owner-supplied: only; original asset: ids never).
Repository integrity: compliance-critical roles keep their PINNED generationPolicy (a different-but-valid policy is rejected, not just an invalid one).
No string in the PageSpec contains a live endpoint of the real site (role liveValues: checkout, newsletter POST, plugin listing, company mailbox, Lemon Squeezy legal, affiliate.js).
At most one featured plan, and it is the first plan (pricing-plan--featured carries no extra CSS but marks plan 1).
